prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE square premium painterly naturalistic Mythics illustration, 1024x1024 or larger. Portray Apollo of ancient Greek Delphi as one awe-inspiring living god, a handsome YOUNG ADULT MAN with a smooth BEARDLESS face and LONG wavy dark-golden HAIR, ONE head, TWO normal eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs. Noble focused serene expression, heroic grounded presence. He stands on the broad stone steps of a monumental Greek sanctuary, full figure entirely inside the square, very low camera angle, small columns and distant valley structures establish mythic scale. Wear a FULLY OPAQUE ivory Greek chiton from shoulders to ankles, securely covering chest, torso and legs, with a rich amber-purple mantle. One hand holds an elegantly simple SILVER BOW pointed downward; the other supports a beautifully readable TORTOISESHELL LYRE with two arms, crossbar and strings, grounded instrument design, no weapon-instrument hybrids. Beside him stands a smaller ancient BRONZE THREE-LEGGED SACRIFICIAL TRIPOD, associated with his Delphi oracle, in clearly visible silhouette. Apollo is god of light: powerful warm golden radiance enters through the high temple opening and bathes the god and steps in broad cinematic beams, but ordinary unlit eyes, no flaming body, NO sun disk or spiked solar crown, no chariot, no claim he is Helios. Light, bronze and marble are realistic material textures, majestic music/oracle/light presence, rich painterly brushwork, deep teal shadows. No other gods, no killing scenes, no extra heads/arms/legs, no nudity or see-through cloth, no generic laser magic, no runes, no modern film/game/anime/comic designs, no text/letters/logo/border/watermark.
